```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Creating a DataFrame from the provided dataset
data = {
    "StichtagDat": ["2024-12-31", "2025-12-31", "2019-12-31", "2020-12-31", "2021-12-31"],
    "StichtagDatJahr": [2024, 2025, 2019, 2020, 2021],
    "AlterV10Lang": ["30- bis 39-Jährige"] * 5,
    "SexLang": ["männlich"] * 5,
    "KreisLang": ["Kreis 7", "Kreis 7", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10"],
    "Rasse1Text": ["Deutsche Dogge", "Deutsche Dogge", "Continental Bulldog", "Continental Bulldog", "Continental Bulldog"],
    "AnzHunde": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Setting the plot style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot of the number of dogs by breed and year
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=df, x='StichtagDatJahr', hue='Rasse1Text', palette='viridis')

# Adding titles and labels
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Breed and Year', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Year', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Breed', fontsize=12)

# Saving the plot as output.png
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
```
